method: Manual complete source read and AST syntax only; publisher not invoked.
passed_source_invariants: Fixed dataset identity and authenticated Publicus admin account required.
Expected parent is compared at initial read and immediately before commit; create_commit includes parent_commit.
Existing remote identities are recorded at pinned parent and preserved except two explicitly mutable paths.
Addition paths are unique, restricted to release prefix and unoccupied unless one of the two mutable pointers.
Both mutable pointer updates must be in the plan.
Local payload pins and 256 MiB per-file bound checked before commit; exact pins rechecked after verification.
Observed commit OID is set in state and written to commit-observed.json before remote verification.
Remote LFS SHA256 and size are checked; small non-LFS payloads downloaded at exact commit and canonical cache-blob digest verified.
All prior immutable remote identities checked after commit; final main revision must equal observed commit.
Closed receipt preserves failure status and observed external commit when a later verification fails.

resolved_prior_issues.resolution: stable_read(..., retain_plan_bytes=True) returns at most 2 MiB of the same no-follow regular FD bytes whose SHA256 is compared; json.loads parses exactly plan_bytes. Plan re-pin occurs immediately before create_commit and after verification.
stable_read requires absolute canonical paths, opens O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK, requires stat.S_ISREG, and compares dev/inode/mode/size/mtime/ctime before and after the FD read.

scope_limits: Source review only; no actual upload, remote parent observation or actual file-plan approval is claimed by this review.
Canonical path resolution and stable FD reads are not atomic openat containment or an atomic snapshot across upload.
Actual uploaded identities are verified after commit; local source races result in a retained failed-publication receipt.
Recorded prior immutable file count assumes both explicit pointer paths exist at the expected parent; actual release already contains both.
Credential classification of concrete plan payloads and actual closed bulk publication remain separate root obligations.
